products.label: GALACTICNUCLEUS central catalogue, CDS J/A+A/631/A20
products.process: Keep the stars brighter than Ks 14 and redder than H - Ks 1.3 inside two half-light radii of the cluster, thinned to the cluster's share of the star counts; place each at its sky position, at a depth along the sight line drawn from the cluster's published Sérsic fit; tone by Ks as observed.
limitations: A star's depth within the cluster is drawn from the cluster's measured shape, not measured.
Dust in front of the cluster hides its stars south-west of Sgr A*.
